workflow_instructions.mode_overview: AutoCAD Researcher mode provides comprehensive research workflows for exploring AutoCAD APIs, finding technical documentation, and identifying implementation patterns for AutoCAD automation. This mode specializes in researching AutoCAD COM interfaces and providing technical guidance.

step.title: Define Research Scope
step.description: Understand the specific AutoCAD research requirements and focus areas

actions.action: Identify the AutoCAD API or functionality to research
Set up research tools and documentation sources

step.title: Gather Research Sources
step.description: Locate and organize AutoCAD documentation and reference materials

actions.action: Access AutoCAD developer documentation and API references
Find official Autodesk resources and examples
Locate community resources and implementation examples
Identify relevant research tools and methodologies

step.title: Plan Research Strategy
step.description: Design the approach for comprehensive AutoCAD research

actions.action: Define research methodology and systematic approach
Plan validation methods for research findings
Set up tracking for research progress and findings

phase.name: documentation_research
phase.description: Research official AutoCAD documentation and API references

steps.step: Search AutoCAD developer documentation for specific APIs
Find official method signatures and parameter requirements
Locate error code documentation and troubleshooting guides
Identify version compatibility and deprecation notices
Document official implementation examples and patterns

phase.name: api_exploration
phase.description: Explore AutoCAD COM interface and object models

steps.step: Examine AutoCAD COM object hierarchy and relationships
Research property and method availability across versions
Identify parameter types and data format requirements
Explore alternative approaches for API limitations
Document integration patterns and best practices

phase.name: implementation_guidance
phase.description: Provide implementation guidance and code examples

steps.step: Create Python code examples using pywin32
Document parameter marshalling and VARIANT array handling
Provide error handling patterns and recovery strategies
Identify performance optimization techniques
Create troubleshooting guides for common issues

phase.name: validation_testing
phase.description: Validate research findings through testing and verification

steps.step: Test research findings in controlled AutoCAD environment
Verify API behavior across different scenarios
Validate parameter requirements and error conditions
Document testing results and observations
Refine research findings based on validation results

test_category.name: documentation_accuracy
test_category.description: Verify accuracy of research findings and documentation

tests.test: Cross-reference findings with multiple documentation sources
Validate API signatures against AutoCAD runtime behavior
Verify parameter requirements with actual implementation
Test error handling scenarios and recovery mechanisms
Confirm version compatibility across target AutoCAD versions

test_category.name: implementation_validation
test_category.description: Test implementation examples and code patterns

tests.test: Verify Python code examples work with pywin32
Test parameter marshalling with various data types
Validate error handling and exception management
Confirm performance characteristics of recommended patterns
Test integration with broader AutoCAD automation systems

completion_criteria.criterion: Comprehensive AutoCAD API documentation researched and documented
Accurate method signatures and parameter requirements identified
Error handling patterns and troubleshooting guides created
Research findings validated through testing and verification
Documentation organized for easy reference and implementation
